profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer with expertise in third-party integrations, customer support, and automated testings
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in Java, Spring Boot, and AWS. Im a strong engineering professional with a Bachelor’s Degree focused in Computer Science from Georgia State University and 8+ years of experience in a wide range of industries.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Sandy Springs, Georgia, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Backend-focused engineer driving scalable integrations and AI-powered analytics for construction project controls, enabling SmartPM to deliver proactive insights through RFI and Submittal data.

• Led development of a new integration framework connecting SmartPM with Procore and Autodesk Construction Cloud, enabling ingestion and normalization of RFIs and Submittals.

• Designed and implemented data ingestion and mapping pipelines to transform partner data into SmartPM’s unified model, forming the foundation for analytics and automation.

• Collaborated on AI-driven logic to determine which project activities are most at risk when RFIs remain unanswered or Submittals are delayed, improving proactive decision-making.

• Built robust validation, error handling, and TDD-backed microservices in Spring Boot to ensure reliability, scalability, and maintainability.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected and designed key components of a sophisticated web application using Spring Boot, enabling end-users to seamlessly schedule and manage one-on-one meetings.

• Spearheaded the architecture and design of a critical web application module using Guice, allowing end-users to efficiently allocate and adjust compensation data.

•Developed and deployed a Kafka-based solution to schedule and manage application notifications, ensuring timely updates for end-users regarding changes in one-on-one meetings.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Spring Boot · React.js · Guice

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led third-party integrations with BMW, Mercedes, and Honda, extracting critical car data and serving as the subject matter expert in customer calls.

• Enhanced contact center experience, reducing support tickets by 17%, and played a key role in streamlining customer support processes.

• Spearheaded a 10% decrease in defects through an initiative to increase automated tests, fostering collaboration between development and QA teams.

• Actively mentored junior team members, facilitating knowledge transfer and fostering their professional growth within the software engineering domain.

• Led initiatives to identify individual team members' strengths and areas for improvement, tailoring mentorship to enhance technical and soft skills.
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Back-End Web Development · Git · Spring Boot · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Code Review

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Architected and designed critical components of a sophisticated web application in React, empowering end-users to seamlessly schedule jobs for processing enrollment data.

• Led the migration of a legacy application from vanilla Java, JavaScript, and Oracle to a cutting-edge solution using React and Spring Boot.

• Engineered a robust solution for processing enrollment data efficiently, ensuring accurate and timely transmission of information to insurance providers.

• Implemented best practices in data handling and processing, resulting in increased system reliability and reduced processing times by 12%.

• Enhanced test coverage by identifying and addressing gaps in the automated testing strategy, reducing new defect creation by 8%.
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Problem Solving · TypeScript · Databases · Java · Apache Kafka · Back-End Web Development · React.js · Communication · Front-End Development · Spring Boot · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Code Review · Object Oriented Design

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented custom integration layers connecting Flastract with Sage and Procore, reducing double data entry by 40% and enhancing operational efficiency for new and existing customers.

• Orchestrated strategic integrations with Sage and Procore, optimizing import/export processes and creating a cohesive system, improving data consistency by 30% for Flastract.

•Implemented automated testing processes and CI/CD pipelines, ensuring the reliability and scalability of integration layers, resulting in a 25% reduction in deployment times.
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Problem Solving · PostgreSQL · Databases · Integration · Back-End Web Development · Communication · Start-ups · Code Review · Object Oriented Design

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Conceptualized and designed a user-friendly web application enabling seamless price adjustments and discount management, supported by Java Spring web services, improving pricing operation efficiency by 15%.

• Engineered a comprehensive web application for SKU allocations and assortments across stores and distribution centers, leveraging Java Spring web services to enhance inventory management efficiency by 10%.
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Problem Solving · PostgreSQL · Databases · Back-End Web Development · Communication · Front-End Development · Code Review · Object Oriented Design

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained full-stack web applications and data transformation tools using AngularJS and Java (Spring), boosting system performance by 8% and streamlining data processing by 12%, with comprehensive unit and integration testing.

• Designed and built intuitive UI components, improving user experience and reducing data transformation errors by 10%, while implementing a backend messaging system that decreased data processing time by 13%

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Had an Agency Special Background Investigation and Polygraph

• Worked at Lockheed Martin Facility with The Boeing Company

• Worked on a Business Integration Platform

• Contributed to the creation of an application to provide evaluation feedback utilizing AngularJS

positions.title: Mobile Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Redesigned agent search view, updated elements of UI to fit current standard practices

• Updated logic from Objective-C to Swift as well as optimized to work seamlessly with the rest of the app

• Worked on the conversion of legacy State Farm applications from Objective-C to Swift

• Updated elements of UI to fit, then, current standard practices

• Built UI elements for new State Farm applications

• Optimized logic to clear up standing errors in new State Farm applications

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description:
• Helped Design Home and Feature Pages of LEARNORA Website

• Fixed minor bugs (improve UI) for the pages

Helped Test Entire Website that includes front-end and database validation
